name: Akiflow
tagline: The planner UI can be built, but bringing every task source into one reliable, two-way calendar workflow means OAuth, APIs, sync conflicts, and maintenance.
verdictSummary: KINDA: Akiflow costs $34/mo ($408/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
